title: Oven Hash Browns
description: Crispy frozen hash browns on a sheet pan in the Samsung oven's Air Fry mode.

ingredients.item: salt, pepper, garlic powder, or your favorite seasoning

steps: Preheat oven on Air Fry mode to 425°F. Lightly oil a sheet pan.
Shredded: spread in a thin, even layer, no thicker than 1/2 inch. Drizzle oil and season. Patties: single layer, brush or spray both sides with oil.
Cook 10 to 12 min. Flip with a spatula (shredded: flip in sections).
Cook another 8 to 12 min. Done when deep golden and crisp at the edges.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R2
notes:
Serves 2 per half sheet pan. 20 to 30 min total. Cooking for 1 on a work night: make a half batch, same temp, check a few minutes early.
Foil removed Oct 25, 2026 (Joe has no foil); per Joe via Meal Plan.

healthy: Potatoes give potassium and some fiber.
Oven baked with only 1 to 2 Tbsp oil instead of deep frying.
not_healthy: Salt and seasoning blends add sodium.
